description: Strikemaster Mk 82A listed as gate guard / preserved at 'RAFO Ghala' (bacstrikemaster.co.uk survivors list c.2010; dstorm.eu 'gate guard RAFO Ghala'). Ghala is a district of Muscat adjoining Al Ansab, near the Sultan's Armed Forces HQ complex; the exact RAFO establishment is not identified by the sources. No dated photo found; current status unverified.

Ex-RAF XF396, converted to FGA.73A, ex-Royal Jordanian Air Force 844, to Oman 1975. Thunder & Lightnings Hunter survivors list: '844 (ex XF396) FGA.73A, RAFO Gallah (displayed on parade ground), Oman'. Undated entry; no photograph found. dstorm.eu does not give a fate for 844. Needs on-site confirmation.
